notes.title: Unveiling Origins: Director’s Cut Gameplay and Q&A
notes.notes:
🎮 Missed the Live Broadcast? We've Got You Covered! 🎮

If you missed it on Wednesday, you have another chance to watch our Game Director, Fernando Rabello, play 'The Light of the Darkness: Origins' in an exciting recorded session! Join us for an exclusive look into the game's rich lore and mechanics.

What Awaits You:

🔹 Deep Dive into the Lore: Discover the intricate and captivating story that forms the backbone of 'The Light of the Darkness: Origins.'

🔹 Gameplay Mechanics Unveiled: Get a firsthand look at the core mechanics that make our game unique, from our unique flying through the  dynamic map with no loading times, and the intense soulslike combat.

🔹 Explore Diverse Biomes: See the stunning and varied biomes that you'll traverse in the game, each with its own unique challenges and beauty.

🔹 Engaging Q&A Session: Hear Fernando answer questions from the community, providing insights and behind-the-scenes details about the game's development.

Don't miss this opportunity to get an inside look at 'The Light of the Darkness: Origins.' Stay tuned to our game's page for the broadcast!

notes.title: The Light of the Darkness: Origins – Developer Playthrough and Insights
notes.notes:
Dive into the mystical world of "The Light of the Darkness: Origins" during our exclusive Steam Next Fest livestream. Watch as our game director takes the helm, guiding you through an immersive playthrough that showcases our game's unique physics-based flying mechanics and captivating dark fantasy universe.

Engage directly with the creators in real-time as they demonstrate the game's core mechanics, discuss the intricate design choices, and reveal insider secrets about the game’s development. Whether you're a long-time fan or a newcomer, this livestream is your chance to see the game's latest features before anyone else, ask questions, and get a behind-the-scenes look at what makes "The Light of the Darkness: Origins" a truly unique gaming experience.

Join us to discover the richly crafted world, master complex challenges, and hear firsthand about our exciting upcoming features planned for Early Access and official launch. Don’t miss this opportunity to connect with the developers and gain deeper insights into a game that blends dark fantasy with breathtaking adventures!

notes.title: Dive into 'The Light of the Darkness' Lore!
notes.notes:
🎉 We're thrilled to share our introductory lore guide for "The Light of the Darkness" universe, now accessible on the Community Hub. This guide provides a broad overview of the universe and its key elements, laying the groundwork for our upcoming game, 'Origins.'

But that's just the beginning! In the coming weeks and months, we'll be releasing bite-sized sections that delve deeper into specific subjects, including character arcs, regions, cities, the idiom, mythology, the pervasive role of Essence in society's fabric, and much more.

Moreover, we want our community to [b]co-create the Lore[/b]. Your feedback and suggestions will play a vital role in shaping the narrative and expanding the depth of our universe.

These releases will be informed by your feedback and requests, ensuring that we cover the topics that matter most to you. So, join us on this journey of exploration and discovery as we unravel the secrets of the Origins tale together.

Spread the word and invite fellow gamers to join our community! Your support helps us grow and create an even better experience for everyone. Thank you for being part of our journey!

🔍 Keep Exploring,

QUARTOMUNDO Team. 🚀

Join Us for an Exclusive Live Stream Event: Unveiling the Mysteries of The Light of the Darkness: Origins

Greetings, adventurers and lore seekers! We're thrilled to invite you to this livestream event dedicated to "The Light of the Darkness: Origins," exclusively on Steam. Prepare to dive deep into the heart of our game's universe, where dark intertwines with light.

What Awaits You:

Never-Before-Seen Trailers: Witness the unveiling of brand-new trailers that offer a glimpse into the epic journey that awaits. Experience the stunning visuals, captivating storylines, and the rich, immersive world we've crafted with passion.

Developer Talks: Join our creative minds behind "The Light of the Darkness: Origins" as they share insights into the game's development process, from concept art to the final touches. Discover the inspiration behind the game, the challenges we overcame, and the secrets that lie within its depths.
